If you’re going for a classic three-strand braid, section your hair down the middle into two equal parts. For a more intricate look, consider a fishtail braid, where you’d divide the hair into two sections and alternate pulling small pieces from the outside of each section into the center. Whichever style you choose, make sure to keep tension in your strands to give it that polished look. If you have shorter layers, you might want to use bobby pins to secure any loose ends as you work your way down. Once you’ve completed your plait and reached the end, secure it with a small hair tie that matches your hair color for a seamless finish.
